fusions.name: Cold Rivet
fusions.desc: Drives a rivet into a target up to 3 tiles away, which deals 30 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, ignores resistances and leaves it [Muddled] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sown Caltrops
fusions.desc: Scatters a 4-tile line of caltrops ahead of you for 5 seconds. It deals 7 damage to each enemy that crosses it and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Proof Against Glamour
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is turned aside and sent back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Kept Oiled
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%, and your other abilities come round 5% sooner.
